references.text: God promised Abraham the land from the River of Egypt to the great river, the Euphrates, which corresponds to the same boundaries mentioned here.
God describes Israel's borders from the Sea of Reeds to the Philistine sea, and from the wilderness to the Euphrates River.
Moses describes the same land area that God promised, including Lebanon and the Euphrates.
The promise of the land's boundaries is repeated: from the wilderness to Lebanon, from the Euphrates to the Western Sea.
During Solomon's reign, the promise was fulfilled when he ruled over all kingdoms from the Euphrates to the land of the Philistines and the border of Egypt.
The description of the land of the Hittites and their settlement areas, which are part of the promised land.
A detailed description of the boundaries of the promised land that God gave to Moses.
Moses was shown all the promised land from Mount Nebo, from Gilead to Dan, and to the Western Sea.
